titleZh: 熱情 ↔ 冷漠｜火山對冰箱
hook: 左邊火山噴火（ardent/ardor），右邊冰箱貼自己（apathetic/callous）——溫度計當場罷工。
script: ardent／ardor／fervid／zealous 火山隊。apathetic／callous／stolid／phlegmatic 冰箱隊。考場口令：火山寫熱情句，冰箱寫「無所謂」。

members.speakLineEn: Ardent fans waited outside the theater despite the cold evening rain.
members.speakLineZh: 熱心熱情的粉絲不顧傍晚冷雨，仍在戲院外等候。

related.synonyms: fervent, fervid, fiery, impassioned, perfervid, torrid

members.speakLineEn: Youthful ardor for the cause kept volunteers working past midnight.
members.speakLineZh: 對這項事業的年輕狂熱，讓志工工作到午夜之後。

related.synonyms: ardour, elan, zeal, fervor, fervour, fervency

members.speakLineEn: Fervid applause followed the choir's final high note in the chapel.
members.speakLineZh: 合唱團在小教堂唱出最後高音後，爆發狂熱掌聲。

members.speakLineEn: A zealous volunteer arrived early to set up every folding chair.
members.speakLineZh: 熱情的志工提早到場，把每張折疊椅都排好。

members.speakLineEn: Her impassioned speech about clean rivers moved the whole town meeting.
members.speakLineZh: 她充滿激情的愛河演說感動了整場鎮民大會。

related.synonyms: ardent, fervent, fervid, fiery, perfervid, torrid

members.senseAnchor: 熱情奔放的；興高采烈的
members.speakLineEn: Ebullient performers bounced onstage and waved to every section of seats.
members.speakLineZh: 熱情奔放的表演者跳上舞台，向每個座位區揮手。

related.antonyms: apathetic, listless, noneffervescent, still, restrained, subdued

members.speakLineEn: Apathetic voters skipped the local election and later regretted it.
members.speakLineZh: 冷漠的選民略過地方選舉，後來才感到後悔。

members.speakLineEn: A callous indifference to suffering.
members.speakLineZh: 例句對齊：硬心腸的。

related.synonyms: cauterize, cauterise, indurate, pachydermatous, calloused, thickened

members.speakLineEn: The stolid watchman barely blinked when the siren finally stopped.
members.speakLineZh: 警報終於停時，冷漠遲鈍的守衛幾乎眨都不眨。

members.speakLineEn: A phlegmatic...and certainly undemonstrative man.
members.speakLineZh: 例句對齊：冷靜遲鈍的。

members.speakLineEn: The committee gave lukewarm support and delayed any real funding.
members.speakLineZh: 委員會只給不冷不熱的支持，並拖延真正的資金。

members.speakLineEn: A halfhearted apology without changed behavior convinced nobody.
members.speakLineZh: 沒有改變行為的不認真道歉，說服不了任何人。

members.speakLineEn: The nurse checked the thermometer twice before recording the fever.
members.speakLineZh: 護理師把溫度計查看兩次後才記錄發燒數值。

members.speakLineEn: Hot lava from the volcano cooled into black rock along the shore.
members.speakLineZh: 火山熔岩沿著海岸冷卻成黑色岩石。

members.speakLineEn: She dropped one icecube into the tea and watched it melt slowly.
members.speakLineZh: 她把一顆冰塊丟進茶裡，看它慢慢融化。

members.speakLineEn: With a small shrug, he admitted he had forgotten the meeting time.
members.speakLineZh: 他輕輕聳肩，承認自己忘了開會時間。

members.speakLineEn: Scientists warned that the volcano might erupt again within days.
members.speakLineZh: 科學家警告這座火山可能在數日內再度爆發。

members.speakLineEn: Put the leftover soup in the freezer before it spoils overnight.
members.speakLineZh: 把剩湯放進冷凍庫，免得隔夜壞掉。

members.speakLineEn: A tiny spark from the fireplace landed safely on the stone hearth.
members.speakLineZh: 壁爐迸出的一點火花安全落在石砌爐台上。

members.speakLineEn: Morning frost covered the grass and made the path slippery to walk.
members.speakLineZh: 清晨的霜覆蓋草地，讓小路走起來很滑。

members.speakLineEn: A sudden fever kept her home from school for the rest of the week.
members.speakLineZh: 突如其來的發燒讓她整週其餘日子都無法上學。

members.speakLineEn: An evening chill settled over the park after the sun dropped low.
members.speakLineZh: 太陽西沉後，一陣涼快的晚風籠罩公園。
